resources.string: Double-press a volume button to turn the torch on. Double-press it again to turn it off.
Accessibility setting: off. Turn on Simple Torch Launcher in your accessibility settings so the app can see volume button presses.

Android blocks this for some apps installed outside an app store. Open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner and choose “Allow restricted settings”. Then turn Simple Torch Launcher on in the accessibility settings again.
No torch found on this device
Single presses still change the volume, after a short delay.
Also work when the screen is off
Experimental. Works on many phones but not all, and not while music or other audio is playing.
This app is free. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, and no internet access.
Free and open-source software, released under the MIT License.

Lets you double-press a volume button to turn the torch on and off.\n\nSimple Torch Launcher only reacts to volume button presses and ignores every other key. It cannot read your screen, stores nothing, and has no internet access.
